# Support

Need help with one of my projects? Here's where to go:

- **Bugs / feature requests**: open an issue in the relevant repository using the provided templates.
- **General questions**: use the repository's Discussions tab if enabled, or open an issue.
- **Security issues**: see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) — please don't report these publicly.

If you find a project useful, consider [supporting it on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/erictao) ☕.
